composition.method: Compositional proof; not a direct two-execution CPAchecker run
steps: All legal executions satisfy ec==correction(obs) and residual(C E,s) (181 partitions, complete disjoint coverage).
Separate per-run budgets imply s<=1; budget_relaxation implies residual(C E,1).
common_correction: correction() depends only on the observation, so equal complete observations give the same C.
residual_signature establishes the parity/syndrome signature of each C E.
signature_pair proves the ORIGINAL pre-correction E1/E2 pair predicate for arbitrary common C.

commonCorrection.method: Machine-checked: per-run ec==correction(obs) in all 181 partitions + common_correction lemma
commonCorrection.premise: Equal branch, round count and complete per-round syndrome/flag history h0..h7 (including last round)

composition.directPairRuns: Not re-run. Earlier v3 UNKNOWN/ERROR results are not relabeled.

coverage.explanation: Mode 0 ignores unused fields; mode 1 uses only q,a; mode 2 uses round,k,op,p. Each relevant legal input has exactly one partition.
